g1.label: 1. What time should students meet?
g1.why: The recording says all students should meet at nine thirty.

g2.label: 2. Where should students meet?
g2.why: The recording says students should meet on the main field.

g3.label: 3. What to bring because of the weather?
g3.why: The recording says to bring a hat and water bottle because it will be hot and sunny.

g4.label: 4. What happens if it rains?
g4.why: The recording says Sports Day will move to the sports hall if it rains.

g5.label: 5. What is the Parents' Association selling?
g5.why: The recording says the Parents' Association will sell cold drinks and snacks.

g6.label: 6. Which event is Jack considering?
g6.why: The recording says Jack is thinking about the long jump instead of the sprint.

g7.label: 7. Which event will Mia do?
g7.why: The recording says Mia is going to do the eight hundred metres.

g8.label: 8. What time is the relay race?
g8.why: The recording says the relay race is at three o'clock.

g1.label: 1. Noah — strong, loves throwing
g1.why: The text says Shot Put is all about power and strength.

g2.label: 2. Aisha — quick, short distances
g2.why: The text says the Sprint is a fast, short race over in seconds.

g3.label: 3. Leon — prefers teamwork
g3.why: The text says the Relay Race is a team event where you win or lose together.

g4.label: 4. Zoe — good jumper, sand pit
g4.why: The text says the Long Jump involves leaping into the sand pit.

g5.label: 5. Sun cream costs money
g5.why: The text says free sun cream is available at the first-aid tent.

g6.label: 6. First-aid tent next to changing rooms
g6.why: The text confirms the first-aid tent is next to the changing rooms.

g7.label: 7. You have to pay for water
g7.why: The text says water is free all day; only snacks must be paid for.

g8.label: 8. Only the winner gets a medal
g8.why: The text says medals go to the first three places in every event, not just the winner.
